name: billing-export-analyzer
description: Analyzes a cloud billing / cost export you paste into the chat (CSV with a header row: date, service, cost, plus account, tags, region or usage type if present; AWS, GCP and Azure exports are recognised). It returns the period and totals (gross, credits, net), the top movers window over window with code-computed drivers worded as hypotheses, anomalous days (more than 2 sigma off the trailing mean), the untagged share, waste patterns with stated assumptions, a budget run-rate, a finance-readable narrative and a text chart. Every number is computed in code. Follow-ups: only movers, only anomalies, untagged, chart, top 10 movers, compare last 14 days, cost of a service in a region, as json. It never connects to a cloud account and changes nothing; no general questions.

skills.name: Analyze a billing export
skills.description: Totals, top movers with hypotheses, anomalies, untagged share, waste patterns, budget run-rate, a narrative and a text chart from a pasted cloud cost CSV, plus follow-ups on the same analysis.
examples: Analyze this billing export, budget $40k: <paste the CSV>
